historical_numeracy.name: Numeracy · birth-cohort estimate (ABCC)
historical_numeracy.definition: Published estimate of basic numeracy inferred from age heaping (round-number ages), using a transformed Whipple index. Both sexes; a source year denotes people BORN in that decade. Not a literacy rate, school attendance, test score, or years of schooling. Held constant only within the stated birth decade.
historical_numeracy.caveat: Source references modern 2012 country geography, not the historical polity shown on the map. No automatic border reconciliation or numeric uncertainty interval is supplied.

historical_gini_gross.name: Gini · historical gross household income
historical_gini_gross.definition: Published gross-household-income Gini benchmarks: 0 represents equality, 100 maximum inequality. Historical estimates, including conjectures in early periods. Different income/household concepts from modern income-or-consumption Gini; not spliced into the modern series. Benchmark dates only, no Atlas interpolation.
historical_gini_gross.caveat: Source references modern 2012 country geography, not the historical polity shown on the map. No automatic border reconciliation or numeric uncertainty interval is supplied.

historical_daily_baskets.name: Daily labourer wage / subsistence basket
historical_daily_baskets.unit: daily subsistence baskets per daily wage
historical_daily_baskets.definition: Published daily male unskilled construction wage divided by the cost of one daily subsistence basket. A ratio of 2 buys two such daily baskets on a paid day. Not annual family-basket affordability, annual income, GDP per person, or 2011 international dollars. No additional annual-workday or household-size assumption is applied. Source includes reconstructions and source-side interpolations.
historical_daily_baskets.caveat: Source references modern 2012 country geography, not the historical polity shown on the map. No automatic border reconciliation or numeric uncertainty interval is supplied. Selected urban/occupational wage observations are not representative national household income. The compilation can use produce prices and changing wage definitions. Exact cities are not exposed in the compact table; no point location is invented.

historical_gdp_1990.name: GDP per person · historical (1990 PPP)
historical_gdp_1990.unit: 1990 international dollars per person per year
historical_gdp_1990.definition: Annual economic output per person reconstructed by Broadberry and Gardner, in 1990 international dollars. These are published model estimates, not household income. This purchasing-power base differs from the Atlas’s 2011 series; no currency-rate or CPI conversion, splicing, or derived total is applied.
historical_gdp_1990.caveat: Country series as defined in the paper; historical colonial/state coverage is not assumed to match the displayed borders. Reconstruction uncertainty is not quantified for every annual value.

historical_japan_birth.name: Birth rate · Japanese vital statistics
historical_japan_birth.definition: Annual published vital-registration rate, transcribed from the Japanese-language ministry table. Population is the denominator for births/deaths; live births for infant/neonatal mortality.
historical_japan_birth.caveat: Japanese statistical reporting geography as defined by the ministry; no assumption that this covers imperial possessions or matches each historical map boundary. 1944–1946 absent from this table; no interpolation across the wartime gap.

historical_cv_infant.name: Infant mortality · Cabo Verde reconstruction
historical_cv_infant.definition: Published historical rate for Cabo Verde. These tables explicitly concern all Cabo Verde, despite the thesis’s island title. Author compilation of historical reports, not newly verified registers. Some published rates and counts do not reconcile; source rates are retained without silently recalculating them. Missing years stay missing; no interpolation across famine and epidemic years.
historical_cv_infant.caveat: Cabo Verde national archipelago totals/rates as described by the author; not the São Vicente island-only tables.

historical_morocco_population.name: Population · Escallier/HCP estimate
historical_morocco_population.definition: Published Moroccan population estimates shown as rounded millions in HCP’s historical chart, converted to people (×1,000,000). No extra precision or interpolation is implied.
historical_morocco_population.caveat: Historical Morocco as scoped by the source, not an exact boundary crosswalk to the current map.

historical_morocco_south_population.name: Population · former southern zone (regional)
historical_morocco_south_population.definition: Regional population for the source’s Ex-zone Sud, not all Morocco. Source table switches to national coverage after 1951–1952; the Atlas keeps only the pre-1950 regional benchmarks here. Thousands converted to people. The 1947 total includes an estimated component.
historical_morocco_south_population.caveat: REGIONAL: former southern zone of Morocco as defined by the source. Not a national total, not allocated to other territories, and no polygon is fabricated.

historical_china_death.name: Death rate · 1949 retrospective
historical_china_death.definition: Official retrospective historical estimate. Paragraph 死亡率下降，预期寿命提高: explicitly states 1949 death rate of 20 per thousand.
historical_china_death.caveat: China as defined in this retrospective report; no historical-boundary reconciliation. Only the explicitly dated 1949 value is imported.

historical_china_urban_population.name: Urban population · 1949 retrospective
historical_china_urban_population.definition: Official retrospective historical estimate. Paragraph 城镇化进程稳步发展: explicitly states 1949 urban population 5765万人 (57.65 million); not total population.
historical_china_urban_population.caveat: China as defined in this retrospective report; no historical-boundary reconciliation. Only the explicitly dated 1949 value is imported.
